approved_options.SIM_SEATED_VERSION: Fictional clinician-approved seated exercise option for the simulated demo only.

rules: Recommend only an action listed in actions.
Movement modifications must reference an approved option available in the scenario.
Synthetic motion data cannot establish vertigo, dizziness, falls, or clinical effectiveness.
Recommendations are proposals for review and must not control a wearable.
Mandatory safety escalation overrides agent agreement.
